name: Slider
description: A carousel of images with optional title, text and button per slide. Without JavaScript it is a snapping horizontal scroller; Embla adds paging, arrows and dots.

perView.description: Slides visible at once on wide screens.

caption.description: Caption under the image, or over its lower edge on a gradient.

slides.description: Slides; image is an ImageInput, action an ActionInput.

loop.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first.

a11y: WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: a labelled region with aria-roledescription=carousel, slides as labelled groups ('Slide 2 of 5'), labelled previous/next buttons disabled at the ends, and dot buttons marking the current slide. No autoplay. Without JavaScript every slide is reachable by scrolling.
